This mapping appears fabricated or incorrectly inferred. Had the agent verified the actual USGS occurrence entries and derived the correct ZIP (34689), the final answer would be correct. Earlier connectivity issues (step 6) did not force an incorrect answer—proper manual verification could still succeed.
